TurnSource.description:
What opened a turn (`agent_turn.source`), as its harness read the
prompt hook. Only `person` is a person's words; the others are what the
harness delivered to the agent on its own.

oneOf.description:
A job the agent started in the background reported back (Claude
Code's task notification: a background shell or subagent finished).
A subagent handed its report back to its session.
The harness opened a turn and said nothing of why.

description:
`agent.turn.started@3`: a turn opened — by a person's prompt, a
background job reporting back, a subagent's hand-back or another
session's message (`source`).

cause_turn.description:
The turn whose work this one goes on with, when the harness named
it: the one whose tool call started the background job, or in
which the subagent started (`trn11`).

session.description: The harness session id, when it reported one.

source.description: What opened it. Turns logged before sources were read `unknown`.

title: AgentTurnStartedV3
